# Other Roles

```{r other_roles}
library(vitae)
library(lubridate)
vroom::vroom("data/experience.csv") %>%
    filter(institution == "39 Alpha Research") %>%
    mutate(date = as.Date(start, "%m/%d/%Y")) %>%
    arrange(desc(date)) %>%
    mutate(
        start_fmt = format(date, "%b %Y"),
        end_date  = suppressWarnings(as.Date(end, "%m/%d/%Y")),
        end_fmt   = if_else(end == "Present", "Present", format(end_date, "%b %Y")),
        when      = glue::glue("{start_fmt} - {end_fmt}")
    ) %>%
    detailed_entries(
        what  = institution,
        when  = when,
        with  = position,
        where = detail,
        why   = description,
    )
```
